title: Two Dynasty Cards in One Province
summary: Alfredo approved the shared province layout and temporary ordering tray. Please review the native UI and proposed view/command contract for the province portion of #499.
review_steps: Extract the ZIP and open Start Review.cmd. It opens directly to the prepared two-card province.
Inspect the attached Region and each Dynasty card independently. Confirm that they share one province perimeter and number, while Dynasty slots A and B are distinct.
Use the scenario selector for a concealed second slot, an empty slot and a crowded row. Inspect each card and use Other seat to check both player views.
Choose reveal order or refill order, select A or B first, and confirm. The temporary tray should disappear and report the chosen order. This fixture deliberately does not execute card effects.
Resize the window and use Focus province to recenter. Check full scans, labels, separate click targets, tray readability and room around the cards.
Review docs/decisions/2026-09-29-two-dynasty-province.md on PR #544 for the proposed view/command contract. Report UI/QoL or contract changes on Send Feedback.url before engine integration.
known_limitations: Alfredo approved the concept direction; native playability and mechanical acceptance remain for Mendon. Nothing has been merged into main.
This is an isolated presentation fixture with real period scans and intercepted order confirmations. Plains of Otosan Uchi is not made playable by this preview.

The proposed DTO/client contract awaits Mendon review. Authoritative multi-slot state, reveal/resolve/refill/purchase/destruction, private-view production, save/replay, AI and reconnect wiring are follow-up engine work.
Province-less battlefields and the other pending choices in #499 are outside this preview.
Automated Windows packaging/runtime checks do not establish native Windows graphical playability or expert rules acceptance.
Obsolete standalone DuelArenaReview art iterations are source-only; the Windows export keeps current CrimsonDuel gameplay and all card scans.
